root_cause: This is the fifth recurrence of the exact same failure signature first recorded on 2026-09-21 (run 35611485728). job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml installs the locally-built 'openvino' and 'openvino_tokenizers' wheels via install_ov_wheels, but the subsequent 'pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt' pulls in 'whowhatbench', which transitively depends on 'optimum-intel' -> 'openvino-genai'. Pip resolves and installs prebuilt 'openvino-genai-2026.4.0.0' and 'openvino-tokenizers-2026.4.0.0' wheels from the proxy index, silently uninstalling the just-installed local 'openvino-tokenizers-2026.4.1.0' wheel. The 'openvino_genai' native extension then expects a matching libopenvino.so.2640 that was never provisioned in this environment, so the import fails at collection time before any test runs. This PR (#38200) only touches documentation/benchmark artifacts (RST files, a PDF and an XLSX under docs/); it is unrelated to the failure, which is a pre-existing, unresolved infrastructure/dependency issue in the merge-queue pipeline.
reproduction_steps: In a fresh venv: 1) pip install <local openvino-2026.4.1 wheel> <local openvino_tokenizers-2026.4.1.0 wheel>; 2) pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt (pulls whowhatbench -> optimum-intel -> openvino-genai from the index, which drags in mismatched openvino-genai/openvino-tokenizers builds); 3) python3 -c "import openvino_genai" reproduces 'ImportError: libopenvino.so.2640: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory'.
recommended_actions: Pin/constrain 'openvino-genai' and 'openvino-tokenizers' in tests/llm/requirements.txt (or a constraints.txt) so pip cannot silently swap the locally-built wheels for mismatched prebuilt ones during transitive resolution of whowhatbench/optimum-intel.

Install openvino-genai explicitly from the same locally-built artifact set as 'openvino'/'openvino_tokenizers' via install_ov_wheels, before running 'pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt', and pass '--no-deps' (or an equivalent constraint) on the requirements install to prevent it re-resolving/overwriting those packages.

Add a fast-fail 'python3 -c "import openvino_genai"' smoke-check step immediately after wheel installation in job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml so this ABI/version mismatch surfaces clearly instead of as a pytest collection error.

This is now the fifth occurrence of the same unresolved issue across multiple unrelated PRs (currently unrelated to a docs-only PR); escalate to the CI infra owner to land the pin/constraint fix urgently since it is blocking unrelated merge-queue runs.
prevention_strategies: Add explicit version constraints (or install-from-local-wheel steps) for openvino-genai and openvino-tokenizers in tests/llm/requirements.txt / constraints.txt so pip cannot silently substitute a mismatched prebuilt runtime during transitive dependency resolution. Add a CI smoke-import step right after wheel installation for any job that installs additional OpenVINO-dependent python packages, so ABI mismatches fail fast with a clear message instead of as an opaque pytest collection error.
historical_context: Identical failure signature (a87e95431b0e8175) was first recorded on 2026-09-21T15:45:59Z in run 35611485728 (PR #38190), recurred on 2026-09-22 in runs 35717727822 and 35719650364 (PR #38190), and again in run 35742977292 (PR #38329). This is now the fifth occurrence, affecting yet another unrelated PR (#38200, docs-only), confirming the underlying fix has still not been applied to job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml or tests/llm/requirements.txt.
